snippet.title: Shellshock Promo 1
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4524800/Shellshock/

Shellshock releases on Steam on July 15th!

Be one of the first to grab a copy of the game by wishlisting Shellshock on Steam and getting a notification when we launch!
